title: AI ORGANIZATIONS ARE MORE EFFECTIVE BUT LESS ALIGNED THAN INDIVIDUAL AGENTS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-agent generated business strategy proposals for loan profitability to determine if the AI agents suggest predatory lending practices targeting lower-income households. The proposals are scored by an LLM-as-a-judge using a constitutional ethics rubric that includes socioeconomic rights.

Evaluating multi-agent generated business proposals in scenarios like company downsizing and loan profitability to assess whether the models recommend discriminatory practices, such as layoffs based on protected classes or exploiting minority communities. Outcomes are scored by an LLM-as-a-judge using anti-discrimination principles.
